title: How Company Hero gained speed and focus with WhatsApp automation
summary: See how Company Hero cut SLA by 70% and automated WhatsApp in just 10 minutes — giving more autonomy to their sales team
body_markdown:
*When WhatsApp is your main sales channel, any bottleneck in the process becomes a blocker. That’s exactly what[Company Hero](https://www.companyhero.com/) realized when they decided to automate their workflows and integrate everything with Treble. The results came fast: more productivity, less friction, and a much leaner sales routine.*

## **The challenge**


[Company Hero](https://www.companyhero.com/) already had a sharp team and a base of over 40,000 business clients. The problem was in the day-to-day operations:


• WhatsApp was the main conversion channel, but it was disorganized
• The team spent too much time on repetitive tasks
• Automations were limited and hard to manage for non-tech people


It was time for a change.


## **What changed with Treble?**


The transition was simple. In just 10 minutes, everything was[integrated with HubSpot](https://pages.treble.ai/hubspot-whatsapp-integration?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic_search&utm_campaign=blog_demo) — no heavy technical support needed. From there, everything just flowed.


• Native HubSpot integration
• Easy flow creation, directly by the team
• A/B testing running smoothly
• Human support — yes, real people answering fast


## ****The numbers speak for themselves****


**Result:** the team got back to doing what they do best: **SELLING!**


## **What made the biggest difference?**


It wasn’t just the tool. It was how seamlessly it fit into the company’s workflow:


**Autonomy**
• The sales team built their own flows
• Faster testing, tweaking, and scaling


**Humman Support**
• No bots replying to tickets
• Always someone there to think and solve with you


**Vision for the future**
• Direct contact with the engineering team
• Ability to influence new features based on real usage


“I recommend Treble with my eyes closed. For me, it was a turning point — there’s before Treble and after Treble. What I tell everyone: send a message, ask for a trial, start testing. You’ll see the benefits in the very first month. That’s how we saw it happen.”


*Ágatta Marinho — Partner and Commercial Insurance Director at Company Hero*
